correctness.rationale: The rank-three recursively generated Hintikka signatures retain all repeated-vertex equality and adjacency data. Independently implemented nested-set signatures reproduce six classes through n=9. An independent optimized C++ implementation exhausts every n=1..26, with G6..G26 identical and G1..G5 distinct, including exactly nine singleton rank-two profiles from n=6 onward. The explicit G5/G6 rank-two singleton witness distinguishes their rank-three theories; at two rounds n=1 differs from n>=2. The two-endpoint-per-move EF gap invariant t_r=3t_(r-1)+2, t_3=26, preserves all endpoint orders and interval intersection relations in games of three moves for all m,n>=26. Transitivity with the verified n=6..26 bridge proves the infinite statement; finite agreement alone would not.
